game: KC @ BUF, 2025-11-02 16:25 ET, BUF +2.5, total 53.5, outdoor (forecast not saved)

script.base: Competitive outdoor shootout lean: KC is only a 2.5-point road favorite (implied KC 28.0, BUF 25.5) so neither side is priced for a blowout. Both QBs throw, pace is up with a 53.5 total, and KC still runs enough through Hunt after Pacheco is out because Buffalo's run defense is the soft side of the card. Mahomes, with Simmons already out and two other linemen questionable, leans quick and intermediate rather than a pure deep script. Starters should play four quarters.
script.flip1: KC gets up early, kills the clock with Hunt, and Kelce/Worthy/Mahomes yardage stalls late while Buffalo abandons the run so Cook's rushing line dies and Shakir/Kincaid targets spike.
script.flip2: Buffalo jumps ahead at home, KC chases, Hunt carries dry up, and Mahomes volume plus Kelce air yards rise while Cook keeps early carries but loses the late rushing script.

injury_fallout: Known pre-kick from the official nflverse injury report, not final inactives: KC RB Isiah Pacheco Out (knee) vacates 39 carries and 166 rush yards over weeks 6-8. Hunt (19/81 rush L3, almost no receiving — last4 rec yds 8, 11, 0, 2) is the veteran early-down next man; Brashard Smith (17/47 rush and 9 targets/63 yards/-22 air L3) gains satellite carries and checkdowns. KC OL: Josh Simmons Out (personal), Trey Smith Questionable (back), Jaylon Moore Questionable (illness) — one tackle confirmed out, guard and the other tackle are GTDs, so pressure up, rush efficiency down, RB/TE catches up, deep WR yards down. BUF DT DaQuan Jones Out (calf) further weakens a 5.54 YPC run defense; LB Shaq Thompson Out (hamstring) helps TEs, RBs and slot; CB Taron Johnson Questionable (groin) would add slot/TE help if he sits. BUF WR Josh Palmer Out (knee) but only 4 targets/96 yards in the L3 window, so the bump to Shakir (21 tgt), Coleman (17) and Kincaid (9) is modest. No KC defensive outs listed. Johnson, Trey Smith and Moore are unresolved until inactives.

Second overlap is Hunt into BUF's 5.54 YPC front with DT Jones out after Pacheco's carries vacated. Shakir into KC's 7.81 middle YPA is real but lost the two-player cap.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both overs lost. Hunt stayed in a committee: Smith took the explosive touches, Trey Smith was inactive with the back, Simmons was already out, and KC managed a stuffed YPC so Hunt finished 9 for 28 in a game Buffalo led early. Kelce was bracketed, Johnson played, KC got up and ran, and he finished 4 for 48 — the same floor as the recent 54-yard game. The counter is real on both, stronger on Hunt if the OL GTDs go the wrong way, but it is not stronger than the combined read while Jones and Thompson are out and the total is 53.5, so the legs stay and the card is flagged rather than cut.
slip_story: One KC-offense story, not a mixed under: short-handed line and Pacheco out, so Mahomes attacks Buffalo's soft front and vacated middle — Hunt rush over with Kelce rec over. They win together in the base script; flip 1 helps Hunt and can miss Kelce, flip 2 does the reverse, so this is a same-game correlation not a lock. Cook under and Shakir over need a different emphasis and stay off the two-player card. No TD legs, no receptions, no passing yards.
